entities.name: Sami
entities.description: A human captain of the ship Seriema, who goes by they, searches for their lost cat Mirri and is hired to loot a ghost colony.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: A small Kav copilot of the Seriema, a former MemNav pilot who stays with Sami despite his phobia of choice.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Sami's cat, who can weftwalk and vanished from the Seriema, near Uthros.

entities.name: The Metalman
entities.description: A human from outside Pinnacle who hires Sami to find an artifact at Sigma's Reach and who may have lied about the colony.

entities.name: Mm'menon
entities.description: An Illvoi jellyfish of the Uthros Combine who the narrator says will be exiled and will alert the Metalman.

entities.name: Arata
entities.description: A former member of Sami's crew who was the last to leave, telling Sami Mirri is just a cat.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: A star that was to go nova but was killed by the Monoists into a supervoid, ringed with violet light, with children worlds around it.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: The Kav homeworld, torn in two by the Kav's delving and ringed by the Mordraine Ring, Duranuw.

entities.name: Sigma's Reach
entities.description: A colony on the dwarf world Sigma built for mining moxite; it is supposedly empty but is found with its lights on.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: A giant storm world where the Illvoi of the Uthros Combine settled.

entities.name: Anuki
entities.description: Sothera's innermost world, settled by the Monoists and renamed Susur Secundi.

entities.name: Adagia
entities.description: A world of Sothera on which the Sunstar Free Company has set up.

entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: A frozen world with Eumidian terrasymbiosis.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: Sami's worn-out fusion-drive ship, rancid with neutron rot and metal fatigue, with radiator-wings and an aurora aerobrake.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The star-travel organization created by treaty with the Drix that builds eternity columns at dying stars and uses a gift economy of mallow.

entities.name: The Drix
entities.description: Beings who can weftwalk between stars, who gave Pinnacle the secret of eternity columns and search dying systems for things to guard.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: The native people of Kavaron who tore open their world and evolved beneath the star-blood sky.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Worshippers of the Faller who settled Anuki and killed Sothera into a supervoid, the thousandth in their chain.

entities.name: Illvoi
entities.description: Jellyfish beings from where air turns to metal, working in the Uthros Combine.

entities.name: Eumidians
entities.description: Versatile life forms whose seedship planted a brood on Evendo.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: Long-termists on Adagia at war against Sothera itself, whose patrol ship, a palestar, flies near Sigma.

entities.name: Faller
entities.description: The figure the Monoists worship, who they believe transmits his secrets from the edge of the final dark.

entities.name: Mallow
entities.description: Reputation gained by good work in Pinnacle's coinless economy, with duties of host and traveler.

entities.name: Weftwalking
entities.description: The ability of cats and Drix to step between places and stars without ships.

events.summary: A narrator voice asks the reader to make choices that keep the story going, including leaving the Metalman unable to retrieve it.
events.quote: I need you to prevent the Metalman from retrieving me.

events.summary: The Monoists kill Sothera into a supervoid rather than let it explode into a supernova.
Mirri weftwalks away from Sami and vanishes, and Sami is determined to find her.
Sami and Tannuk aboard the Seriema perform main engine cutoff after their flight plan is rejected by Pinnacle.
events.quote: The flight computer stills the main engine.

events.summary: Sami decides to land at the deserted Sigma's Reach and take it for all it's worth, to save it from abandonment.
events.quote: they are going to land at the deserted colony and take it for all it's worth.

events.summary: The Seriema braking through Sigma's atmosphere detects a Sunstar palestar warship, which flies off after something else.
events.quote: The palestar's taking off toward the other side of Sigma, chasing something else.

events.summary: Sami suspects the Metalman's request is a job rather than a favor, and he sent them to find an artifact.
The Seriema approaches Sigma's Reach from the east at sunset of Sothera's black hole.
events.quote: Sothera is now a supervoid, a black hole sun.

events.summary: Sami and Tannuk find Sigma's Reach brightly lit with a welcome sign even though the Metalman said it was empty.
events.quote: WELCOME TO SIGMA'S REACH—POPULATION 13,879 PLUS FRIENDS AND FAMILY

events.summary: Scans show the colony hot, with elevated carbon dioxide and a fission plant but no living thing.
Despite his awful feeling, Tannuk does not ask Sami to abort, and they begin to land.
events.quote: Let's take a look. And then decide how much we can steal.

relations.note: captain and copilot who stay together
relations.quote: Sami prefers to think Tan just really likes them.

relations.note: Sami is the human of the lost cat Mirri
relations.quote: Mirri was the very best of cats.

relations.note: doing a job for him at Sigma's Reach
relations.quote: it's not two good-hearted pillagers doing a favor for the Metalman.

relations.note: created by treaty with the Drix
relations.quote: Pinnacle was created by treaty with the Drix

relations.note: turned the star into a supervoid
set up on Adagia and went to war against Sothera itself
relations.quote: gone to war against—well, Sothera itself.

relations.note: a colony on the dwarf world Sigma
relations.quote: the dwarf world Sigma and the unpopulated colony of Sigma's Reach.
